blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: switch — Connects local devices and forwards data-link frames.
router — Forwards network-layer IP packets between networks.
access point — Connects wireless devices to a LAN.
NIC — Network interface controller for network connectivity.

blocks.title: Local connections
blocks.text: A switch forwards Ethernet frames using learned MAC addresses.

blocks.title: Across networks
blocks.text: Router consults IP destinations and routing information.

blocks.title: Wireless access
blocks.text: Access point bridges wireless stations onto a network.
